name: Wuxi ETEK Microelectronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuxi ETEK Microelectronics Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of analog integrated circuits (ICs) in China and internationally. The company offers power management IC products comprising LDOs, DCDCs, chargers, and PD controllers; power protection IC products consisting of OVP, OVP with RCB, load switches, current limit switches, e-fuses, and TVS; and driver IC products, such as display drivers, transistor arrays, and TOF drivers. It also provides signal chain IC products, including voltage monitors, microphone detection ICs, OPAs, analog switches, level shifters, voltage reset ICs, comparators, hall ICs, I/O expanders…
